note: Configurations this repository has run or intends to run, each tagged against docs/mini/CONFIG_MAP.md, docs/mini/CONFOUNDS.md and docs/mini/ERRATA.md. Audited by tools/config_map.py. A status is about the CONFIGURATION, never about the subject: 'fails' means the config could not measure, not that the loop is worthless.

statuses.works: ran, produced a reading, and no fatal confound applies to that reading
statuses.confounded: ran, but a named confound makes its reading unattributable
statuses.fails: could not measure: the machinery stopped, starved, or refused
statuses.designed: specified and not yet run: says what it tests and what it will not settle, never what it shows

configs.title: Single shot: one conjecture, no loop, no criticism
configs.shows: 1 verified T1 witness at 4 model calls, 0.25 per call: the best yield per call in the block.
configs.proven: The conjecture step produces a real kernel boundary without any loop. Verified by hand against the rule.
configs.not_proven: Nothing about coverage: one target, one witness, one draw.

configs.title: Equal-budget repetition: six independent conjectures, no loop
configs.shows: 4 verified T1 witnesses at 24 model calls, 0.167 per call, over 2 distinct targets: the best yield per call of any arm that ran more than one segment.
configs.proven: Repetition alone reaches both targets the block ever reached. No loop arm beat it per call.
configs.not_proven: That repetition is a ceiling: it was never run at 24 calls.

configs.title: No-return: loop with criticism, organisation never changes
configs.shows: 3 verified T1 witnesses at 47 model calls, 0.064 per call, over 1 target. Its translator dropped the pair texts in 4 of 8 readings (C13).
configs.proven: Nothing about the loop. Its critic read 7 unrunnable rows against 1 result.
configs.not_proven: That a loop without a return path is worthless; this one was starved.

configs.title: Full: loop, criticism, and the organisation rewritten between segments
configs.shows: 3 verified T1 witnesses at 42 model calls, 0.071 per call. It repeated a pair twice while being told not to (A1), and its translator dropped the pair texts in 2 of 8 readings (C13).
configs.proven: The carry is not inert: it was obeyed toward the wrong target, because the critic could not see the layer the errors were in.
configs.not_proven: That the return path buys nothing. That reading was WITHDRAWN.

configs.title: Wired (misnamed): F with the conjecture's commitments rendered, told to attack a reading it could not see

sets.CFG-RENDER: conj renders list_bodies_and_commitments where F renders list_bodies
sets.CFG-INSTRUCTION: critic told to attack the reading by artifact id
sets.CFG-STAGES: criticise ports source, conj, execs -- the reads port is on the KIND and on no stage

configs.shows: 7 witnesses at 43 model calls, 0.163 per call, 2 targets, zero repeats, zero identical-text claims, zero invented functions. Six witnesses found by no other arm. Its translator carried the pair texts in 8 of 8 readings where N's carried 4 of 8 (C13).
configs.proven: That two settings moved together and the yield doubled. Which of them did it is not shown. The reading itself was never rendered: the criticise stage declares source, conj, execs in every segment of the arm (ERRATA C12).
configs.not_proven: The mechanism, withdrawn (C12). Against repetition it is level rather than behind: 0.163 per call against R's 0.167, same two targets (A5).

configs.title: Adjudicated: W plus a criticism that names a target and a ground, and a computed status

sets.CFG-STAGES: adjudicate added; criticise ports source, conj, execs -- the reads port is on the KIND and on no stage
sets.CFG-INSTRUCTION: critic commitment names attacks and ground

configs.shows: 5 witnesses at 41 model calls, 0.122 per call. 2 attacks landed; cannot-tell used once and minted no attack.
configs.proven: An attack can land, and the one that did caught the reading misrendering the conjecture: the error class structurally invisible to N and F. It was caught from the conjecture alone -- the reading was never rendered to this arm either (ERRATA C12).
configs.not_proven: That adjudication does not beat wiring. Four of eight criticism commitments did not parse, so the machinery engaged in under half the arm.

configs.title: Mechanical enumeration over a fixed seed set, no model
configs.shows: 460 collapses at zero model calls, over 8 functions.
configs.proven: Nothing. 458 of the 460 are on functions whose entire range over the seeds is one value.
configs.not_proven: Anything about what a mechanical search can do: the seeds, not the search, were the limit.

configs.title: Repaired baseline: seeds found per function so the function varies
configs.tests: Whether a mechanical search, given inputs that actually make each function vary, finds collapses a model arm does not. CONF-BASELINE-E could not: 458 of its 460 collapses were on functions constant over its seeds. The repaired pool is 62 seeds and still leaves only 10 of 66 functions non-constant, which is the honest denominator.
configs.not_proven: It will not show what a model contributes beyond search unless the primary measure is one this arm can also score on. grounded_T1 was not (CON-MEASURE-EXCLUDES-BASELINE).

configs.title: Repeated, repaired: no loop, resolution inside the arm
configs.tests: The floor every loop arm must beat. CONF-ARMS-R beat all of them per call at 12 calls and was never run at 24.
configs.not_proven: Nothing about the loop. It is the thing the loop is measured against, not a treatment.

configs.title: Full, repaired: return path with a critic that cannot see the reading

sets.CFG-RENDER: conj renders list_bodies, as on every arm of this block

configs.tests: Replication of the F-against-W contrast with a stochastic floor under it, so the wiring effect is not one draw.
configs.not_proven: It will not show the return path is worthless if it loses: CON-CARRY-AMPLIFIES says the carry is only as good as the critic feeding it, and this arm's critic is deliberately blind.

configs.title: Wired, and actually wired: the readings port declared on the criticise STAGE

sets.CFG-STAGES: criticise ports source, conj, reads, execs
sets.CFG-INSTRUCTION: critic told to attack the reading it is now shown
sets.CFG-RENDER: conj renders list_bodies, as on every arm of this block

configs.tests: Whether the critic seeing the readings raises the yield. This is a FIRST test, not a replication: CONF-ARMS-W never rendered a reading (ERRATA C12), so its doubling is unattributed and no number here is compared with it.
configs.not_proven: Nothing about block 1's effect, which stays unattributed whichever way this falls. And the port and the instruction that uses it move together by design: a port a seat is not told to read is not a treatment, so this measures the pair.

configs.title: Adjudicated, repaired: a format schema with an escape road, and a test that can be attacked

sets.CFG-FORMAT: json_schema on the criticism commitment, ground enum including cannot-tell and test-is-unsound
sets.CFG-STAGES: criticise ports source, conj, reads, execs; adjudicate added
sets.CFG-RETRIES: 3, identical on every kind of every arm
sets.CFG-TOLERANCE: null, identical on every kind of every arm

configs.tests: The experiment. Whether criticism that LANDS beats criticism that is only read, at a point where the format no longer suppresses it -- CONF-ARMS-A had four of eight commitments unparseable -- and where a test-is-unsound ground lets the executor itself be attacked.
configs.not_proven: It will not settle whether mini needs untyped interface dispatch or commitments carrying an eval and a budget. Those stand unrepaired (ERRATA C3, C4) and a block that fixed them is a different machine.

configs.title: Deliberately bad: a closed ground enum with NO escape road
configs.tests: MIS-FORMAT-2 on this machine. DeepReason measures a required closed field without an escape road taking fabrication from 0-2 to 100 per cent; this asks whether attacks land on targets the record does not support when the honest answer is unavailable.
configs.not_proven: A fabrication rate here is about this task and this model. It is a probe of the config, not a result about schemas in general.

configs.title: Schema on the conjecture itself, no separate reading stage
configs.tests: T-D of PIPELINE_MATH directly: whether putting the schema on the conjecture rather than downstream of it loses the wrong readings that make a disagreement visible. It also removes the layer W's critic gained by seeing.
configs.not_proven: If it does worse, that is not evidence for the translator specifically: removing the reading stage also removes a call, so the arms differ in cost unless the budget is matched deliberately.

configs.title: Carry only the last segment, not the accumulated history

sets.CFG-PROBLEM: rewritten from the previous segment only

configs.tests: The risk named in CREATIVITY-ARMS-1's own pre-registration and never tested: the install map makes the brief longer each segment, so a full-carry arm may lose to a short-carry one for a reason that has nothing to do with the return path.
configs.not_proven: It will not separate brief length from brief content unless the two carries are matched on length, which they cannot be while one accumulates.
